claims.statement: For every complete adaptive restriction tree whose root source is a union of three distinct parallel affine cosets, the compensated charges Gamma_v=Omega(s_v)-E[Omega(s_child)|v] satisfy sum_v w_v Gamma_v <= 8 ln(2) I(d), uniformly in dimension, codimension, orientation, depth, and query order; the constant is sharp.
For every union s of three distinct parallel affine cosets, Omega(s) <= 4 ln(2) I(s).
The unrenormalized sum of complete one-node charges has no finite pathwise-nonreuse source-influence constant; the event-local theorem does not revive that statement.
